profile.name: Pongpan Nerunchorn
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer · .NET / Vue
profile.summary: Full-stack developer with 2+ years building a production cloud ERP with Vue 3 + TypeScript and .NET 8 Web API. I've owned modules end to end — from manufacturing and inventory logic to Azure deployment — and I enjoy turning complex business rules into reliable, easy-to-use software.

items.name: BizKit ERP
items.stack: Vue 3 · TypeScript · .NET 8 Web API · SQL Server · Azure
bullets: Built the new Vue 3 + TypeScript SPA and .NET 8 Web API that replaced the legacy Web Forms system — 2,043 commits (1,378 frontend, 665 backend).
Manufacturing module from UI to API: BOM and yield, Work Center, the full Manufacturing Order flow, partial finished goods, material consumption, average costing and production journals.
Inventory: Lot/Serial/FEFO, average unit cost, UOM-conversion validation across all approval flows, Excel import for stock adjustment and BOM.
Multi-tab session handling with BroadcastChannel (leader-only AFK timer, cross-tab login/logout sync, session guards) and API-level permission checks with caching.
Azure: Blob Storage for files and report templates, Azure AD token auth for Azure SQL with transient-error retry, App Service deployment.
Centralized global exception handling and logging with Serilog in the .NET backend.
Migrated PDF reports from HiQPdf v9 to HiQPdf.Next, standardized headers on 20+ Excel reports, moved email from SendGrid to SMTP, and refactored business logic from controllers into a service layer.
Mobile: worked on the Angular + Ionic app, its Vue 3 + Ionic + Capacitor rewrite, and a React Native handheld app for warehouse barcode scanning.

items.name: Client project — Production management system
items.stack: .NET Framework Web API · Angular 9 · SQL Server
bullets: Supported a separate production system for a forging & cutting manufacturer alongside ERP work.
Delivered change request CR02: forging result entry with quantity/weight calculation, WIP lot search, and heat-bar fields on reports.
Redesigned the WIP tag and added routing-process printing on forging return boxes.

projects.name: BizKit ERP
projects.tagline: Cloud ERP (TH/EN) for invoicing, accounting, inventory and manufacturing
projects.summary: A multi-company cloud ERP. I worked across the rewrite from legacy ASP.NET Web Forms to a Vue 3 SPA with a .NET 8 Web API, touching 8 modules on both frontend and backend.
bullets: 2,043 commits over 18 months (1,378 frontend, 665 backend).
Owned the Manufacturing module end to end, from BOM to production journals.
Designed cross-tab session handling and API-level permission caching.
Moved files, templates and database auth onto Azure (Blob Storage, Azure AD, App Service).

projects.name: create-clean-arch
projects.tagline: CLI that scaffolds .NET 10 Clean Architecture solutions
projects.summary: A command-line generator I built so my team can start new .NET projects from a consistent, ready-made structure. It produces a ready-to-run Clean Architecture solution with an optional Vue 3 frontend and CI pipeline.
bullets: Generates a .NET 10 Clean Architecture solution with optional Vue 3 frontend and GitHub / Bitbucket CI.
Generated projects come with JWT login, 2FA and password reset.
`generate feature` adds a new CQRS feature slice to an existing project.
Covered by Vitest unit and end-to-end tests.
Used internally by a team; source not public.

projects.name: Family Expense Tracker
projects.tagline: Full-stack budget and expense app for families
projects.summary: A family budgeting app with approvals, notifications and reports — built to practise Clean Architecture, CQRS and testing end to end.
bullets: Budgets, transaction approvals, notifications, PDF / Excel reports, and Excel import as a background job with progress tracking.
Clean Architecture + CQRS (MediatR), JWT + Google login, 2FA (TOTP) and audit log.
44 test files (xUnit, Moq, integration tests); Bitbucket CI → SonarCloud → Azure.
Also ships as an offline Windows desktop app (Electron + SQLite) with its own installer.
